workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Execute only healthcheck-diagnostic-reuse-continuation once within 540 seconds. Require two passed cases, zero failures or skips, and a settled accepted report. Preserve all original CIS-0001 through CIS-0004 tasks, reports, contracts and accounting.
